proposals: Make zero_fill apply to whole absent days for a camera direction whenever any other direction of the same camera published that day. After 2025-06-24 this feed leaves out entire zero-total days for quiet zones (e.g. 389/735 has 3-17 days a month instead of 28-31), as well as zero slots within days. If zero_fill only fills slots on days that direction published, those weeks would stay short or incomplete even though the camera was running (busy zones 717/786/806 report every day).

useful: overview: the monthly complete_days pivot showed at once when the feed started leaving out zeros (mid-2025) and which zones it affected
daily: zero-day and slots-per-day counts per month showed zero-total days vanish after 2025-06-24 while other zones of the camera kept reporting
slots: summing all zones per slot located the camera-wide outages to the slot, and showed the single-zone bursts on 786 in 2024-06
raw: the Status column confirmed the outage days were flagged warning on every zone
absent_zeros: confirmed the zero omission, though it only flags weeks with not a single zero
not_useful: duplicates, doubled, spikes: nothing found; spikes misses the 786 bursts because its 200-per-slot floor is far above what a low-volume camera does
zeros: on a camera with 1-2 bikes a day per zone, per-direction zero stretches are mostly real and swamp the output; what matters is camera-wide zero stretches
improve: zeros: add a camera-wide mode that reports stretches where every zone of a counter is 0 at once
spikes: scale min_count to the direction's level, or add a mode that flags a zone whose daily total is many times its median while the rest of the camera is normal
absent_zeros: also report direction-days that are missing entirely while other directions of the same counter published
add: camera balance: per day, IN versus OUT (and crossing) totals across all zones of a camera, to show counts that enter a zone without leaving through any other
camera coverage: per day, how many of the counter's directions published and how many slots, to separate feed omissions from outages

summary: One VivaCity-style camera (counter 286) watches 11 zones at Lawrence Hargrave Dr / Rawson St in Coledale, most carrying only a few bikes a day. The feed has three camera-wide outages reported as zeros (2023-09-27 to 10-10, 2023-11-21 to 11-29 and 2024-06-07 to 06-12), which I set missing. From 2025-06-25 it leaves out zero slots and whole zero days (zero_fill), and two single-zone bursts on 396/786 in June 2024 count the same objects many times inside one zone and are set missing; the Gong Ride days (2024-11-03, 2025-11-02) and the monthly Sunday group rides are real.
